Reshape the ground

Grading and yard leveling in Baton Rouge

Reshape the low, soggy or uneven parts of your yard so water runs off and the space is usable again.

Request an estimate Call (225) 324-8252
The problem

A yard that will not drain is usually a grading problem.

Low corners, ruts and settled spots collect water and stay muddy for days. Adding topsoil on top rarely fixes it - the ground has to be reshaped so water has somewhere to go.

We re-establish fall across the yard, tie it into drainage where needed, and finish so the surface is smooth and mowable.

What's included
  • ✓Assessment of fall and low points
  • ✓Reshaping and re-grading the surface
  • ✓Fill and compaction where needed
  • ✓Tie-in to drainage or an outlet
  • ✓Final grade for sod or seed
  • ✓Cleanup and restoration
Grading & Yard Leveling

Every property is different. Your scope depends on size, materials, accessibility, service frequency, and project scope. Free consultations and customized written estimates are always available.

What affects your estimate
  • Area to be graded
  • Amount of fill required
  • Drainage tie-in needed
  • Equipment access
  • Sod or seed to finish

Questions

Grading & Yard Leveling FAQs

Grading or drainage - which do I need?
Often both. Grading moves water across the surface; drainage carries it away underground. We assess and recommend the right mix on a free site visit.
Will you re-sod after grading?
We finish to a clean final grade and can install sod or seed as part of the scope.
